result.topic_en: Riemann discusses the sign of a stability-related integral and then treats the second case of the rotating fluid ellipsoid, where two pairs of the quantities u,u'; v,v'; w,w' vanish so that only rotation about a principal axis remains, deriving the reduced equations, the energy integral, and conditions for the axes a and b.
